name: generate_captions
description: Generate a project's caption track from everything audible on its timeline and write project["captions"]. Mixes every unmuted video item on every enabled visual track together with every unmuted audio track (voiceover, music, sfx), each at its own timeline position, transcribes that mix (multilingual, timeline-time word timings), groups words into styled caption segments, and merges any prior caption theme (position/color/fontsize/bgColor/accentColor). Mute is read at generation time only. CLI-subprocess equivalent of the /projects/{id}/captions SSE route. Run async (montaj_step async:true) — transcription with the 'large' model is slow — and poll montaj_step_status. Takes a project id, not a file input.

input.description: No file input — operates on a project by id (see project-id param).

output.description: The caption track JSON ({"style", "segments":[...]}) that was written to project["captions"].

params.name: model
params.description: Whisper model. Larger = slower + more accurate. Use 'large' for non-English.

params.name: language
params.description: Language code (e.g. en, es, fr), or 'auto' for language auto-detection.

params.name: style
params.description: Caption animation style. Defaults to the prior caption track's style, then 'pop'.
